title: langlands-gl2-modularity widget params
description: The proven GL_2 case of global Langlands over Q, made arithmetic: pick an elliptic curve E/Q of prime conductor N (11a, 19a, 37a), and the widget point-counts a_p(E) = p+1 - #E(F_p) live for each good prime p and shows it equals the q-expansion coefficient a_p(f) of the weight-2 newform f in S_2(Gamma_0(N)) attached to E. The Modularity Theorem (Wiles for semistable, Taylor-Wiles, Breuil-Conrad-Diamond-Taylor in general) is exactly the statement that these two sequences agree for all p, equivalently L(E,s) = L(f,s); on the Galois side it is the assertion that the 2-dimensional l-adic representation rho_{E,l}: Gal(Q-bar/Q) -> GL_2(Q_l) on the Tate module matches the cuspidal automorphic representation pi_f of GL_2(A_Q). The newform coefficients are taken from LMFDB (labels 11.2.a.a, 19.2.a.a, 37.2.a.a) and the curve-side a_p are computed by genuine point-counting in the browser, so the visible match is two independent computations agreeing. The conductor prime p=N (bad multiplicative reduction) is excluded from the point-counting table. No numeric params beyond the standard widgetId/title/hint.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.
